description: @font-face block generated from the font file: family, weight, style, stretch and unicode-range read from the font — Reads a font you supply as base64 (up to 2 MB, any of TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2) and writes an @font-face rule for the URLs you will serve it from, for an agent or build step generating CSS: font-family from the name table, font-weight from OS/2 (or the fvar wght range of a variable font), font-style, font-stretch, and unicode-range from the cmap. Names and URLs are escaped as CSS strings. It does not

family.description: Overrides the family name read from the font.

fontBase64.description: Base64 of a .ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2 file (not a .ttc collection), up to 2 MB.

includeUnicodeRange.description: Default true; omitted automatically for fonts with more than 300 cmap ranges.

sources.description: One entry per file you serve, best format first.

format.description: The format() hint for that file.

url.description: Where you will serve this file; written into url(). Quotes, backslashes and control characters are escaped.

name: font-face-css
